scheme_name: Indo-French Postdoctoral Research Programme for Women in Science
other_conditions: Applicants must be women and Indian or French citizens.
Applicants must be affiliated with a recognized university or research institution in India or France.
Indian applicants must hold a PhD degree and have a sanctioned/tenured post in a scientific/academic institution.
French applicants must hold a PhD degree and be currently completing a postdoctoral project.
The mobility period must occur during the applicant's employment at the institution.
Applicants must not have received any postdoctoral fellowship in France or India in the last 5 years.
The fellowship cannot be taken simultaneously with any other fellowship.
Preference is given to candidates without prior international exposure.
Preference is given to candidates with prior R&D experience and publications.
CEFIPRA may relax eligibility conditions for potential candidates.
benefits_summary: Indian nationals receive €2000 per month plus allowances and travel; French nationals receive ₹90,000 per month plus allowances and travel.
